deterministic_issue_discovered_from_froz.description: The parent contract requires all six fresh query-grammar stress rows to skip invalid exact-visible pre-dispatch, execute source_canonical_name, and resolve. Literal reuse of V7 query-plan inclusion semantics would omit source_canonical_name whenever frozen name_key(canonical_query_name) equals frozen name_key(visible_name). Five of the six frozen fresh grammar-stress rows have equal semantic name keys because frozen name_key removes their unsupported surface characters/diacritics. Therefore the parent contract's required six canonical executions and literal V7 representation-generation wording are internally inconsistent before any V8 NGS observation.

frozen_clarification.query_representation_generation: Preserve V7 ordered representations, except that when exact_visible_name fails the frozen NGS term_pattern and deterministic source_canonical_name exists, differs as a source string from visible_name, and passes the frozen term_pattern, source_canonical_name MUST be included as the next source-native representation even when its frozen semantic name_key equals visible_name's name_key. If a terminal_suffix_stripped representation exists before it under V7 ordering, retain that representation in order and subject it to the same pre-dispatch grammar guard. Surname-only remains after source_canonical_name.
frozen_clarification.invalid_representation_behavior: A representation failing the frozen term_pattern is recorded as skipped_pre_dispatch_query_grammar and issues no request. No character deletion, replacement, transliteration, fuzzy repair, manual alias, or manual query construction is permitted.
frozen_clarification.semantic_resolution: Unchanged from frozen V7/V8: candidate displayName may match the frozen semantic name_key of visible_name or deterministic source_canonical_name; team equivalence, GSIS validation, position+jersey tiebreak, fail-closed behavior, and all forbidden fields remain unchanged.
frozen_clarification.executed_query_stop_rule: Unchanged from parent V8 contract: after an executed request, continue only after HTTP 200 + parseable players array length 0; stop on nonempty players array or any executed transport/parse failure.
frozen_clarification.query_grammar_stress_gate: Unchanged: all six fresh stress targets must skip invalid exact-visible pre-dispatch, execute source_canonical_name, and resolve uniquely; every executed request must be HTTP 200 with a parseable players array.
